findings.finding: The consumer contract defines HSAR documentation consumption and future versioned adapters but does not implement or test a live HSMART runtime integration.
findings.disposition: Correctly treated as a documentation-only contract. Any future runtime coupling requires a separately versioned API/adapter, explicit owner, source contract, permissions and host tests.

findings.finding: Event-driven synchronization is specified but not configured or verified; the contract requires scoped Notion integration access and protected Actions secrets.
findings.disposition: Keep synchronization NOT_CONFIGURED or BLOCKED until a least-privilege pilot passes create/update/no-op, duplicate, stale-source, permission, auth, timeout, rate-limit, redaction and read-back tests.

findings.finding: The six primary plugins are designated as HSAR spearheads, but this PR does not provision their separate runtimes or prove their call-through on HSMART.
findings.disposition: Require actual invocation receipts and requested/observed version records for each role. Procedure fallback must not be reported as a plugin invocation.

findings.finding: The 4+2 rubric and feature-gap score model are documented but no comparative benchmark on matched HSMART source objects is included in this documentation PR.
findings.disposition: Run matched-scope comparative pilots during a later authorized L1-L3 scan. Preserve N/A when evidence is unknown and do not aggregate incomparable scores.

findings.finding: Checkpoint, backup and restore requirements are defined but an actual restore/replay exercise is outside this documentation PR.
findings.disposition: Keep backup/restore runtime status NOT_RUN until an isolated restore, hash/schema/count verification and idempotent replay produce real receipts.
